clips.send: A rectangle’s area is width times height equals pi r times r . It is built from exactly the circle’s pieces, so the area of a circle is A equals pi r squared
clips.text: A rectangle’s area is width × height = pi r times r. It is built from exactly the circle’s pieces, so the area of a circle is A = pi r 2

clips.send: This number, the same for every circle, is called pi: pi equals C over d equals 3.14159 and so on , a decimal that never ends or repeats. So C equals pi d , and because d equals 2r , also C equals 2 pi r .
clips.text: This number, the same for every circle, is called pi: pi = over C d = 3.14159 ldots, a decimal that never ends or repeats. So C = pi d, and because d = 2r, also C = 2 pi r.

clips.send: Here is a wheel whose diameter, the blue line straight across the middle, is 1 unit. Mark the spot touching the ground. If the wheel rolls exactly one full turn, how far does it travel?
clips.text: Here is a wheel whose diameter, the blue line straight across the middle, is 1 unit. Mark the spot touching the ground. If the wheel rolls exactly one full turn, how far does it travel?

clips.send: Roll! When the red mark touches the ground again, the wheel has laid its whole rim flat on the ground. That yellow path is the distance around the circle: its circumference, C .
clips.text: Roll! When the red mark touches the ground again, the wheel has laid its whole rim flat on the ground. That yellow path is the distance around the circle: its circumference, C.

clips.send: Try it with a 30 cm pizza. The crust is C equals pi times 30 is about 94.2 cm. For area use the radius, 15 cm: A equals pi times 15 squared is about 706.9 square centimeters .
clips.text: Try it with a 30 cm pizza. The crust is C = pi times 30 approx 94.2 cm. For area use the radius, 15 cm: A = pi times 15 2 approx 706.9 cm².

clips.send: Now the area: how much space is inside? Slice the circle into 8 equal pieces, like a pizza. All the yellow crust together is the circumference, 2 pi r .
clips.text: Now the area: how much space is inside? Slice the circle into 8 equal pieces, like a pizza. All the yellow crust together is the circumference, 2 pi r.

clips.send: Is that just this wheel? Unroll circles with diameters 2 cm, 3.5 cm and 5 cm. Bigger circles have longer circumferences, but C divided by d is always about 3.14, because every circle is a scale copy of every other circle.
clips.text: Is that just this wheel? Unroll circles with diameters 2 cm, 3.5 cm and 5 cm. Bigger circles have longer circumferences, but C div d is always about 3.14, because every circle is a scale copy of every other circle.

clips.send: Cut thinner slices: 16, then 48. The bumps flatten and the slanted ends stand up straight. The shape gets closer and closer to a rectangle, pi r wide and r tall.
clips.text: Cut thinner slices: 16, then 48. The bumps flatten and the slanted ends stand up straight. The shape gets closer and closer to a rectangle, pi r wide and r tall.

clips.send: Line the slices up, alternating tip-down and tip-up. The bumpy shape is almost a parallelogram. Half the crust is along the top, so the top is 1 over 2 C equals pi r long, and the height is about r .
clips.text: Line the slices up, alternating tip-down and tip-up. The bumpy shape is almost a parallelogram. Half the crust is along the top, so the top is over 12 C = pi r long, and the height is about r.

clips.send: Measure it with diameters: 1, 2, 3, and a little bit more, about 0.14 of a diameter. So the circumference is a bit more than 3 diameters: C is about 3.14 times d .
clips.text: Measure it with diameters: 1, 2, 3, and a little bit more, about 0.14 of a diameter. So the circumference is a bit more than 3 diameters: C approx 3.14 times d.

clips.text: 把这些小块一个尖朝下、一个尖朝上交错排成一排，得到一个凹凸不平、近似平行四边形的图形。一半的饼边在上面，所以上边长 over 12 C = pi r，高约等于 r。

clips.send: 滚起来！当红色记号再次碰到地面时，轮子的整个边缘都“铺”在了地面上。这条黄色的路径就是绕圆一周的长度——圆的周长 C 。

clips.send: 再来看面积：圆里面有多大？像切比萨一样，把圆平均分成 8 块。所有黄色的“饼边”合起来就是周长 2 派 r 。

clips.send: 这个对所有圆都相同的数叫作圆周率 派 : 派 等于 d分之C 等于 3.14159 …… ，它是一个无限不循环小数。所以 C 等于 派 d ；又因为 d 等于 2r ，所以 C 等于 2 派 r 。
clips.text: 这个对所有圆都相同的数叫作圆周率 pi: pi = over C d = 3.14159 ldots，它是一个无限不循环小数。所以 C = pi d；又因为 d = 2r，所以 C = 2 pi r。

clips.send: 长方形的面积 等于 长 乘 宽 等于 派 r 乘 r 。它正是由圆的各块拼成的，所以圆的面积是 A 等于 派 r的平方
clips.text: 长方形的面积 = 长 × 宽 = pi r times r。它正是由圆的各块拼成的，所以圆的面积是 A = pi r 2

clips.send: 只是这个轮子才这样吗？把直径为 2 cm、3.5 cm、5 cm 的圆都“展开”。圆越大，周长越长，但 C 除以 d 总是约等于 3.14，因为任何两个圆都互为比例图。
